description: This Java class 'HtmlMenuRendererImage' extends 'HtmlMenuRenderer' and provides functionality to generate HTML image tags for menu items, fetching associated content and URL details. It is part of the OFBiz framework's widget rendering for HTML menus.

classes.name: HtmlMenuRendererImage
classes.description: A specialized renderer for HTML menus that generates image HTML tags based on menu item content, used within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: HtmlMenuRendererImage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with HTTP request and response objects.

methods.name: buildDivStr
methods.description: Generates an HTML image tag string for a menu item, retrieving content URL and setting optional width and border attributes.
